name: Dismiss
description: Adds a "Dismiss" button to Drupal messages, warnings, and errors.
project_description: Dismiss is a very lean front-end module that adds a jQuery-powered "Dismiss" (close) button to every block of Drupal status, warning and error messages so a visitor can hide messages that are in the way without reloading the page. It ships a single Drupal behavior (js/dismiss.js) that prepends a close button to each .messages container and hides that container on click, plus a small stylesheet for the button. The library is attached to every page via hook_page_attachments(), so it works site-wide with no configuration, no routes, no permissions and no dependencies beyond Drupal core. Dismissal is visual only and lasts for the current page render; the module does not persist the dismissed state and does not stop Drupal from generating the messages.
